verdict.rationale: The PlayCanvas Engine is open-source (MIT) and published on npm, with documented standalone use, and paid plans offer 'Download Apps for Self-hosting', so you can run the runtime and your published apps on your own infrastructure. The Editor, however, is documented as browser-based with work saved to PlayCanvas's cloud, and community users note code must live on PlayCanvas servers with no offline editing, so the full product cannot be self-hosted. Missing for 10: a self-hostable or offline Editor/collaboration backend, and documentation of any on-prem deployment of the platform.
